## Compare average expression of the TE per genotype to the maternally expressed tes 
```{r}

# Or integrate directly into pivot_longer workflow:
log_cpm_batchCorrected_tes_selected$X<-NULL
expression_df <- log_cpm_batchCorrected_tes_selected
expression_df$TE <- rownames(expression_df)

long_data <- expression_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -TE,
    names_to = "sample_name",
    values_to = "expression_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Genotype = case_when(
      grepl("^F1_ddm1_", sample_name) ~ "F1_ddm1",
      grepl("^F1_Col_", sample_name) ~ "F1_Col",
      grepl("^ct_col_", sample_name) ~ "ct_col",
      grepl("^ddm1_ct_", sample_name) ~ "ddm1_ct",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Accession = sub("^[^_]+_[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", sample_name),
    Replicate = sub("^[^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", sample_name),
    Plate = sub("^[^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", sample_name),
    Sample_ID = sub(".*_([^_]+)$", "\\1", sample_name)
  )

# Check results
head(long_data)
table(long_data$Genotype, useNA = "always")
```

## Merge with maternally expressed 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Prepare allele-specific data (sum both alleles per sample)
allele_summed <- maternally_expressed_tes_tes %>%
  group_by(sample_id, ID, Genotype, Variant, Accession) %>%
  summarise(
    total_log2_CPM = log2(sum(CPM) + 1),  # Sum CPMs then log transform
    .groups = "drop",
  )

# 2. Prepare non-allele-specific data
non_allele <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    ID = TE,
    total_log2_CPM_bulk = expression_value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, ID, total_log2_CPM_bulk, Genotype, Accession)

# 3. Merge datasets
# Convert Accession to the same type in both dataframes
non_allele$Accession <- as.numeric(non_allele$Accession)
allele_summed$Accession <- as.numeric(allele_summed$Accession)
non_allele$Sample_ID <- as.numeric(non_allele$Sample_ID)
# Now the join should work
comparison_data <- allele_summed %>%
  inner_join(
    non_allele,
    by = c("sample_id" = "Sample_ID", "ID", "Genotype", "Accession"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  )

# 4. Calculate correlation
cor_result <- cor.test(
  comparison_data$total_log2_CPM,
  comparison_data$total_log2_CPM_bulk,
  method = "pearson"
)
```

```{r}
  qnorm((rank(x, na.last="keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(x)))
}
```

## Connect to the sampleinfo
```{r}
sampledata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tm3_phenotype_preprocessed_based_on_pca_with_selfers_v2.csv",header=T)

filtered_data$sample_id <- as.numeric(filtered_data$sample_id)
sampledata$Sample_id <- as.numeric(sampledata$Sample_id)
```

##Get BLUPs
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)

## Calculate BLUP
blups <- filtered_data_with_info %>%
  {
    model <- lmer(log2_CPM ~ (1|acc_variant) + (1|Replicate), data = .)
    varcomp <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
    var_acc <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "acc_variant"]
    var_replicate <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Replicate"]
    var_resid <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Residual"]
    h2 <- var_acc / (var_acc + var_replicate + var_resid)
    
    tibble(
      Accession = rownames(ranef(model)$acc_variant),
      BLUP = ranef(model)$acc_variant[,1],
      #Residuals = resid(model),
      h2 = h2
    )
  }


blups$Genotype <- gsub("^.*?_(F.*)", "\\1", blups$Accession)
blups$Accession <- gsub("_.*", "", blups$Accession)
blups_fin <- pivot_wider(blups, id_cols=Accession, names_from=Genotype, values_from=BLUP)



## Fit the model
filtered_data_col <- filtered_data_with_info[filtered_data_with_info$Genotype=="F1_ddm1",]
model <- lmer(log2_CPM ~ (1|Accession) + (1|Replicate), data = filtered_data_col)
varcomp <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
var_acc <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Accession"]
var_replicate <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Replicate"]
var_resid <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Residual"]
h2 <- var_acc / (var_acc + var_replicate + var_resid)

## Get residuals 
residuals <- resid(model)
## Regression diagnostics
fitted_values <- fitted(model)
plot(fitted_values,residuals)
hist(residuals)
#qqplot of residuals
qqnorm(residuals)
qqline(residuals)
```

## Create phenotype 
```{r}

long_data$acc_var <- paste(long_data$Accession,long_data$Genotype, sep="_")
heritability <- long_data %>%
  filter(Genotype %in% c("F1_ddm1", "F1_Col")) %>%
  group_by(TE, Genotype) %>% # Group by both TE and genotype
  group_map(~ {
    df <- .x
    te_id <- .y$TE
    geno_id <- .y$Genotype
    model <- lmer(expression_value ~ (1|acc_var) + (1|Replicate), data = df)
    varcomp <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
    var_acc <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "acc_var"]
    var_replicate <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Replicate"]
    var_resid <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Residual"]
    h2 <- var_acc / (var_acc + var_replicate + var_resid)
    resids <- residuals(model)
    tibble(
      TE = te_id,
      genotype = geno_id,
      heritability = h2,
      var_acc = var_acc,
      var_replicate = var_replicate,
      var_resid = var_resid,
      residuals = resids
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()
```
